title: Cobblemon Atlas
description: Cobblemon Atlas is a unique Cobblemon server with both adventure and survival modes!
body:
## **The Official Modpack for Cobblemon Atlas** ### IP: **play.CobblemonAtlas.com** This is the modpack that is required to play on the **Cobblemon Atlas** server. Join and explore our server with our incredible community, unique region, and tons of features! Some of these features are listed below!
Server Features • Custom Region and Storyline
• Pokedex Completion Ranks
• Custom Regional Pokemon
• Cosmetics
• Custom Terrain for Survival Worlds
• Tournaments
• GTS
• Auction House
• Breeding
• Land Claiming
• Plushies
• Server Events
• Raids
• Hunts
• Mega Evolutions
• Z-Moves
• Terastalization
• Trainer Cards
• Resource Worlds
• Player Gyms
• Rotating Competitive Formats
• Player To Player Wondertrade
• Custom Emotes • And More...
![Paragraph Break](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/342605d41c5608b7803d657290b8d85f0176e46b.png) ### Join our Discord Below! [![atlas discord invite](https://discordapp.com/api/guilds/1469175015646826670/widget.png?style=banner2&n=-1)](https://discord.gg/cobblemonatlas) ![Paragraph Break](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/342605d41c5608b7803d657290b8d85f0176e46b.png) ### Technical Details • Recommended to run with a minimum of 3 GB of memory. Use 4 GB for the best performance. ![Paragraph Break](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/342605d41c5608b7803d657290b8d85f0176e46b.png)
